players.product: Nickel (Ni) ultrafine metal powder for internal electrodes

quarterly_data.quarter: Toho Titanium press release: Toho Titanium to Expand Production Capacity for Ultra-Fine (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Toho Titanium has decided to expand production capacity for smaller-particle-size ultra-fine nickel powder used in the internal electrodes of high-end MLCCs. It plans to phase new equipment into operation at its Chigasaki Plant (Kanagawa) beginning in 2027, doubling its production capacity for smaller-particle-size products, and will subsequently expand supply capacity in stages in line with demand trends. The company cites anticipated demand growth from AI data centers and other applications; it makes the powder at its Chigasaki and Wakamatsu (Kitakyushu) plants. No investment amount or tonnage stated.
quarterly_data.figure: smaller-particle-size Ni powder capacity doubling; new equipment phased in from 2027
